summary: Static verification of Shoonya OAuth reconnect-context fix. Independently re-ran the new regression harness plus all prior harnesses, workspace typecheck, api build, and NestJS boot-sanity. All checks pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shoonya controller uses self-contained encoded state token in cookie; callback recovers via decodeOAuthState(stateParam) ?? decodeOAuthState(readCookie(...)). Verified: shoonya_callback_context_harness => 10/10 ALL PASS; shoonya_oauth_harness 9/9; fyers_account_isolation ALL PASS; fyers_reconnect ALL PASS (S1..S10); upstox_redirect_env 4/4; manual_search_exchange 8/8; integrity_dedupe_exchange 9/9. pnpm -r typecheck => 6/6 PASS. pnpm --filter @cts/api build => PASS. NestJS boot mapped GET /brokers/shoonya/{login,callback} and /api/brokers/shoonya/{login,callback}; process fails only at PrismaClientInitializationError (DATABASE_URL missing) AFTER routes resolve — expected in this pod. No live Shoonya OAuth round-trip (no DB/preview available); logic-level verification complete.
rca_of_the_issue: Shoonya does not echo OAuth state; original code fell back to a random-id cookie whose value was looked up in an in-memory Map (not shared across instances / not restart-safe), so tradingAccountId was undefined after callback. Fix stores the self-contained encoded state token directly in the cookie; callback decodes it (state param path still preferred for brokers that echo state, keeping Fyers/Upstox unaffected). Fail-safe: tampered cookie decodes to undefined. HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax + Path=/ preserved.
